evidenceReport.title: Candidate evidence report
evidenceReport.description: Create a separate local JSON report. Your associations are not independently verified. Scores and model narrative are omitted; source matching is not proof of a qualification. Review all included personal information before downloading or sharing.
evidenceReport.historical: This assessment is historical or unavailable. Its report will not associate current evidence or show current snapshots.
evidenceReport.includeClarification: Include this private answer as a source
evidenceReport.requirementsHelp: Copy exact requirement text from the job description. Choose a supplied source or leave a visible evidence gap. You choose this list; it may be incomplete. Repeat a requirement to include another source.
evidenceReport.changed: Inputs or inclusion choices changed. Prepare and review a new report before downloading.
evidenceReport.failed: The report could not be prepared or downloaded. Try again.
